column7: 2026-11-04: Decision for run_pending job errors: run all other due jobs, then re-raise the FIRST exception (option 2). Reason: supervisor restarts the worker and pages someone on crash, so errors must not be logged-and-swallowed. Also reschedule the failed job (try/finally around job_func in Job.run) so it doesn't hot-retry every tick, since next_run currently stays in the past on failure. Not built yet; implement next session. Open: ExceptionGroup vs first-exception only (user said first exception); keep older-Python support in mind.

2026-11-04: 2026-11-04: Implemented run_pending error handling (run all due jobs, re-raise first exception; try/finally in Job.run to reschedule). Uncommitted. Tests for it not written yet: other jobs still run, first exception re-raised, next_run advances after failure.
